_doc: TWA (Trusted Web Activity) configuration for Google Play Store distribution
setup_steps: 1. Deploy the web app to production with HTTPS enabled
2. Verify manifest.json is accessible at https://YOUR_DOMAIN/manifest.json
3. Generate Android signing key: keytool -genkey -v -keystore nust-events.keystore -alias nust-events -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
4. Get SHA-256 fingerprint: keytool -list -v -keystore nust-events.keystore | grep SHA256
5. Update public/.well-known/assetlinks.json with the SHA-256 fingerprint
6. Option A (Recommended): Use https://www.pwabuilder.com/ — paste your URL, generate Android package
7. Option B: Use Bubblewrap CLI — npm i -g @nicedoc/nicedoc-cli then bubblewrap init --manifest=https://YOUR_DOMAIN/manifest.json
9. Upload to Google Play Console → Create new app → Upload AAB
10. Complete store listing, content rating, pricing → Submit for review
digital_asset_links_note: The file at public/.well-known/assetlinks.json must be served at https://YOUR_DOMAIN/.well-known/assetlinks.json with Content-Type: application/json and no redirects.
